### GET `/v1/organizations/{orgId}/projects`

**List the projects in an organization**

Newest first. Soft-deleted projects are hidden unless `status=deleted`. Paged with the canonical envelope `{ data, has_more, next_offset }` - BREAKING: `count` was removed. Read `has_more`, never a row count compared against `limit`, and pass `next_offset` back as `offset` to continue; it is null on the last page.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orgId` | path | string | yes |  | Organization id, `org_…`. |
| `status` | query | string | no | one of `active`, `suspended`, `deleted` | Defaults to everything except `deleted`. Pass `deleted` explicitly to see soft-deleted projects - they still hold their slug, so this is how you find out why a create 409d. |
| `limit` | query | number | no | 1 to 200 | Page size. Clamped to 200 by the repository regardless. |
| `offset` | query | number | no | min 0 |  |

### POST `/v1/organizations/{orgId}/projects`

**Create a project**

The `environment` chosen here is permanent. `slug` defaults to a normalised form of `name` and must be unique within the organization. Rate limited, and subject to a per-organization ceiling (`MAX_PROJECTS_PER_ORGANIZATION`) that counts live projects only.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orgId` | path | string | yes |  | Organization id, `org_…`. |

#### Request body

`application/json`, required - [CreateProjectDto](./schemas.md#createprojectdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | max 200 chars |  |
| `slug` | string | no | 2 to 64 chars | Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Unique within the organization. Derived from `name` when omitted; a supplied slug is validated, never rewritten. |
| `environment` | string | no | one of `test`, `live`; default `"test"` | CANNOT BE CHANGED LATER. Defaults to `test`, so a project is never created live by omission. API keys minted here must carry the matching prefix (wk_test_/wk_live_) and the ingest path re-checks the pair on every request. |

### DELETE `/v1/organizations/{orgId}/projects/{projectId}`

**Soft-delete a project**

Sets `status = deleted`. Nothing is erased: endpoints, API keys and the whole delivery ledger survive, the project stops being visible to this API, and the ingest path refuses its API keys. The slug stays taken. Returns the project in its deleted state.
